verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Ollama letting users define event-triggered rules or automations. The pack covers model running, its REST API and SDKs, and launching coding agents. OpenClaw messaging integrations are a separate third-party assistant, and building automations on the API would be a developer building block, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
